content: Pita hatulin vakasin vu hil bel-ate vu Yelusalem
Sinaale-so osin Omaaho Bop-ate hil vaalu sen dando Yudiaa-to lango banye nambe hil vaalu sen sil-ame Yudaa-to lako Anutu-te tanasin lak,
om Pita laah valup Yelusalem atombe Yuda pin lanêêl yi.
+ o 11:3 Sin 10:28; Gal 2:12*Lanêêl nambe, “Gala vu hil sen sil-ame Yudaa-to be gaha vanôôn having sil.”
Lemu Pita hatulin va pin sen hango de yii-to vu sil nambe,

+ o 11:5-15 Sin 10:9-48*“Sa nando monaalohak vu taaku Jopa, tonde saahe taahu taahu ti, ond saahe de vati nambe tôômb bopaata ti luus-ambe laam, ond landuuh hôôk nanyendangga yumbeyuuh, de sil taaluuhin vu baandoni be laam voon vu sa.
Tombe saawiingin nambe anjak vaa-ju ni om saangget lôôt, le vahivak vaha vaha sen naale nala de nahaavak osin manak pin nando hôôk lopayo.
Tombe sa hango lava ti laam vu sa nambe, ‘Pita, okandi ganyiis vahivak-anja be gangga.’
Lemu saanêêl nambe, ‘Omaaho Bop, malis lôôt. Va nipaya osin va bamaan nambêênja ond same naha bôôy e.’
Tonde lava ango lom vu baandoni tu balon yuuh vu sa nambe, ‘Va sen Anutu samu be nivasa lak-ato, ond game ganjêênin naambe nipaya le.’
Omaaho Bop nêêl vakasin nambêênju balon yuuh having tu balon yaal, le mem va pin-anju lak-ambe laah baandoni.
Tonde pavis atombe saahe omaaho yaal lato daale bayêên sen hey nando hôôk-ato vinavi, ond omaaho ti nando Sisalia nêêl-ambe yaal lalaam in sa.

Tombe Vavi Vaambuung nêêl vu sa nambe, ‘Gana gaving yaal de game gakam yu-yuuh e.’ Tombe halingg-aso namaavaalu vindak ti nganjo laving sa be hey ala hato omaaho sen wiing omaaho yaal lalaam in saa-to baan,
le mem hatulin vu hey nambe yi de angela ti hato naale yite bayêên alo be nêêl vu nambe, ‘Gambiing hil lana gako Simon sen haale ango nambe Pitaa-to vu Jopa be lanom
+ o 11:14 Sin 16:31*in naanêêl vakasin ti vu hong, ond vakasin e dôôvu hong gaving gate hil pin.’
+ o 11:15 Sin 2:4*Tombe sa naahen naanêêl vakasin lakala, tonde Vavi Vaambuung lakala sil, yik nambe sen lakala yiiy bôôy-ato,
+ o 11:16 Sin 1:5*tombe sa kangg vu Omaaho Bop-ate vakasin sen nêêl-ato nambe, ‘Jon lipis hil-ato ond lipis sil lak bel, lemu Anutu navu biing Vavi Vaambuung naas mando gaving ham.’
Om sen Anutu vu Vavi Vaambuung vu sil-anju, ond yik timu sen vu vu yiiy bôôy sen yaawii-having Omaaho Bop Yesu Kalisii-to, om sa vaati sen saanggilin Anutu-te mop jeen in sil?”

+ o 11:18 Sin 13:48; 14:27*Om hil pin sen dandôô-juuto lango Pita-te vakasin-anju be lavand ma, de lako Anutu haale lak nambe, “Om Anutu hilin hil sen sil-ame Yudaa-to londpayo in nambe sil mando metumin gaving.”
Hil bel-ate vu Antiok

+ o 11:19 Sin 8:1-4*Hil sen lavuuh taale hôôk busin sen layiis Stiven-ande lawiing nindanjeen vu sil vaaluu-to, ond hil sen lavuuh taalêê-juuto vaalu lala taaku dinaandiin heey, taaku Pinisia yuuh Saiplas, de Antiok, tombe lanêêl tanasin vu hil Yuda malis, de me-lanêêl vu hil vaalu le.
Lemu hil vaalu vu Saiplas de vu Sailini ond sil latok lala Antiok, be lanêêl Omaaho Bop Yesu-te banye nivasa vu hil Glik having,
+ o 11:21 Sin 2:41*tombe Omaaho Bop-ate niwêêk nando having sil, om hil ngeeyaata lahilin londpayo be lawii-having Omaaho Bop.
+ o 11:22 Sin 4:36*Lawii-having atombe hil bel-ate vu Yelusalem lango banye, tombe lawiing Banabas la Antiok.
+ o 11:23 Sin 13:43; 14:22*La hato le yi nambe Anutu samu sil nivasa, tombe pêêlis de kaandu sil pin lak tanasin nambe yoo londpayo niwêêk, de sil oo mosapa Omaaho Bop timu jak busin pin.
+ o 11:24 Sin 2:41; 6:5*Banabas-anju omaaho nivasa, wii-having niwêêk lôôt, de Vavi Vaambuung hôôvu yi, tombe hil ngeeyaata latu Omaaho Bop-ate hil.
+ o 11:25 Sin 9:30*Tombe sim Banabas la Taasas in nambe salo Saul,

+ o 11:26 1Pi 4:16*tombe tovu yi om giiy-ambe yuuh lalaah Antiok, be yuuh dando having hil bel-ate vu Antiok ta ti lôôt, in yuuh davu taahu hil ngeeyaata hôôk Anutu-te tanasin. Tombe lanêêl Yesu-te hil vu Antiok nyendoos nambe hil Kalisten.
+ o 11:27 Sin 13:1; 15:32*Tombe hil sen danêêl Anutu-te vakasin langaah-ato heey vu Yelusalem-ambe lala lato Antiok,

+ o 11:28 Sin 21:10*ond sil ti haale nambe Agabas, ond Vavi Vaambuung vêêl lu lak om kandi be nêêl vakasin langaah nambe, “Meep bopaata navu naam nohvu taaku pin.” Tombe vakasin-anjo nôôn ak hôôk busin sen Klodias tu Lom-ate omaaho lulemak-ato.
Om Yesu-te hil lanjôôy vakasin munggin nambe sil pin daasupin mone yuuh ame sen nando vu sil-ato nohvu sil namand pin, be lambu na in dôôvu Omaaho Bop-ate hil vu Yudia hôôk busin sen meep naam-ato.
+ o 11:30 Sin 12:25*Tombe lasupin lung la, le mem lawiing Banabas ayuuh Saul lako be lala vu himbop-aso vu Yudia.
